title: Meta
summary: Render metadata selected from the active route or root module.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Takes no props and requires application context. Place it in the root Layout head.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Renders title, meta, link, and JSON-LD elements from metadata descriptors. The active route’s meta function receives the current loader data, params, error, and URL. If it is absent, the root meta function is used.

sections.title: Example
sections.body: Define metadata in a separate meta.ts file, re-export it from the route module, and render Meta in the shared document layout.

sections.title: Selection and updates
sections.body: Route and root descriptors are not merged: an active route returning [] suppresses root fallback metadata. The browser title is synchronized when a title descriptor is present. JSON-LD is serialized with serializeData so embedded less-than characters cannot close the script element.
